Dell PowerEdge R7515 server

Specifications:
  • Dell PowerEdge R7515 single (1) socket, 2U rack-mount server
  • 24 x 2.5" bay backplane cabled for up to 4x NVME direct bays
    24x SAS/SATA or 16x SAS/SATA + 4x U.2 NVME bays
  • AMD EPYC 7H12 processor with 64 cores & 128 threads
    2.6GHz base, 3.3GHz max, 256MB L3 cache, 280W TDP
  • 128GB total memory using DDR4/PC4 registered/ECC RDIMMs
  • PERC H740P RAID mini-mono RAID controller with 8GB NV-cache w/battery
  • 4x 900GB 10k SAS Hard Drives
  • 2x 960GB U.2 NVME SSDs 
  • 2x 750W EPP power supplies with NEMA 5-15P to C13 power cords 
  • iDRAC 9 Enterprise license is installed.
  • TPM 2.0
  • High Performance (HPR) Fans
  • High Performance Heat sink (HPR HSK)
  • Two (2) half-height/low-profile slots & riser with two (2) full-height PCIe slots
  • Dual port 2x 1Gb Base-T RJ45 LOM
  • Network card with 2x 10Gb Ports
  • Standard Locking 2U Bezel
Warranty - SCSISTUFF 1 year parts replacement with telephone support
